**Visual Analysis of Test Image:**
- Soybean plant pulled from soil, stem split longitudinally
- **Pith is WHITE/cream** — not brown
- Root system is severely decayed: roots are blackened and rotted
- Lower stem/root junction shows extensive dark tissue decay

**Key Diagnostic:**
The white pith is the critical distinguishing feature. Per the symptom descriptions: *"The pith remains white, which distinguishes SDS from brown stem rot."* Brown Stem Rot would show brown pith; here it is clearly white/cream.

The severely rotted black root system combined with the white internal pith perfectly matches Sudden Death Syndrome. The SDS reference image confirms this pattern — decayed roots and characteristic root system destruction.
